canvas.bridgeTitle: Connect Canvas with the local import assistant
localTokenSteps: Sign in to your school's Canvas and open Account in the upper-right corner.
Under Approved Integrations, select + New Access Token.
Use local import as the purpose, choose a short expiry, then select Generate Token.
Copy the token and paste it only into the local import assistant, never into a web page.
canvas.localTokenWarning: To protect your Canvas credential, do not paste this token into the CourseJesus website. The local helper uses a hidden input and keeps the token only in its current process memory; closing the helper removes it.
bridgeSteps: Download and fully extract the Windows x64 portable package. Do not run it inside the ZIP file.
Double-click CourseJesus-Canvas-Bridge.exe. Python, WSL and PATH changes are not required.
After the assistant opens, return here, generate new connection details, then copy them into the assistant.
Enter the Canvas token only in the assistant. Return here to choose courses and start the import.

taskSteps: In Canvas, open Account → Settings → + New Access Token.
Set Purpose to CourseJesus one-time import, choose the shortest useful expiry, then select Generate Token.
Paste the token below, enter the school URL, then select Confirm and choose courses.
The page shows the Canvas account and readable courses. Select courses, then start the import.
After file reads finish, the server destroys the token; import processing and indexing no longer use it.

help.title: Help
help.direction: A clear direction for every step of learning

start.title: Start learning
start.body: Start with Import from Canvas or Create your own course on the Dashboard. In Courses → All courses, use the plus button to choose which courses appear on your Dashboard.

create.title: Create your own course
create.body: Use the dashed card or Create course at the top of All courses. New courses are private by default and are added to your Dashboard after creation.

files.title: Files and course materials
files.body: Select a filename to preview it, or use its three-dot menu to download. Personal files added to official courses are visible only to you.

learn.title: Learn knowledge and solve problems
learn.body: Learn on the left and solve problems on the right. Drag the divider to adjust the panes. Use the top-left button for fullscreen and Esc to exit.

explanations.title: Question explanations
explanations.body: The question pane keeps the full reference solution. Ask about any revealed step in a separate explanation window that you can drag and resize. This does not change the learning conversation on the left.

history.title: Learning history
history.body: Each mode has its own history entry. Conversations and completed generation records are saved on the server and can be restored after refreshing or signing in again.

calendar.title: Calendar and study plans
calendar.body: Use the planning entry below the calendar. Plans are saved to your account, and completed tasks appear in both the calendar and list.

messages.title: Comments and messages
messages.body: Course comments are visible to people who can access the course. Replies notify you. Only the participants can read a private message.
